rongmei.title: Jau lo! Ringcpui chaeng kasiamh luai lou the

lines: 1. Zau lo! Ringcpui chaeng kasiamh luai lou the,
Kandih khou hei nzianmei le ringhmei;
Ai bam kandikh tikgun daihmei makge.
He! Bumaeng Thanhmei le kaguanh bampaeng makge,
Thuanhpui khuan nra khuan gaimei ni,
Guangh nzaenghmei rui Kalvary khou khaenglou kan the.
2. He! Raguang Na kanloumei ta ninga,
Kalvary le siang loupui thing rukhou;
Ai nkhuaimei khang rui hei tei khang the.
3. Tingkauh le kandih hei rui thai kandiu,
Kalvary le, alungh khou hei guang o.
4. He! Zai guangc lou o, He! Chingbut khou tei,
Ravguangc Lauziu Na rianra khou meiguai;
He! Ana guang o tuna kau guang e.
5. Pou le chaeng kasiamhmei khou zailou o,
Kandih rianra ram hei ningdat lak khe;
Nang lun zauna hei khou tei bam chamhni.
